why_confidence: The logging and vendor parts are backed by templates that check what the customer asked, but neither has been evaluated against the workspace. The storage rule covers only the two named fields, so it misses the other cardholder fields and any raw PAN written to another field. Other parts (encryption, retention, runtime payloads) are not checkable, so the policies cannot make the audit pass.
